{
  "phoneNote": "The photography and restrained green palette suit the gostilna, but its location is buried in the footer rather than established near the introduction.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized hero pushes every action below the first screen, while the prices and opening-hours sections leave substantial unused space.",

    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero image height and move its text panel upward so the headline, supporting text and primary action all fit within the first 800 pixels.",
    "Place a compact address line near the introductory heading on both layouts, with a visible desktop contact or directions link.",
    "Make the desktop prices a balanced five-item layout with smaller price typography, and combine opening hours with location details to eliminate the mostly empty full-width section."
